notes.title: Early June Update
notes.notes:
Added new home room to an early game map.
Adjusted several rooms to remedy possible cheese solutions.
Temporarily removed randomised jump scare sound effect from a late game world.
Missed Heavy Attack (Guardian Ability) no longer ends turn.
Improved clarity of demonic-whistle-watch display.
Other things

notes.title: Nothing Fragment Update
notes.notes:
Fixed catastrophic crash when entering the domain of a particular citizen with certain requirements met. (Charles Wenzel)
Fixed mage end turn bug. (Charles Wenzel)
Added missing nothing fragments.
Fixed several rooms being inaccesible from the map. (Charles Wenzel)
Adjusted visibility and ease of access to a number of secret routes to less obvious maps. (Charles Wenzel)

notes.title: Very Very Small Update 2
notes.notes: Fixed Digital Guardian Ability where an incorrect object would be spawned in some situations [Thanks Charles Wenzel]

notes.title: Very Very Small update
notes.notes: Fixed controller inputs not registering in a late game sequence

notes.title: Nothing Update IV
notes.notes:
Catasrophic Failure: Fixed collision issue [not me]
 Added keyboard prompt on stage 'Peculiar Harm Place' when meeting certain requirements [Zarrg]

notes.title: Nothing Update II
notes.notes:
Catasrophic Failure: Fix to guaranteed crash event when using guardian castling ability on a block.
 Trivialisation Fixes: Changes made to several Anchorite stages to prevent super easy shortcut solutions.
 Simplified inputs for keyboard users at title screen (prompts will now default to keyboard when using a keyboard)
 Adjusted transparency of green light gnomes when inactive.
 Map changes - Milkseal: Small adjustments to level layout.
 Steam screenshoting now enabled.
 Other smaller changes.
